# v2.36-dev Release Notes

## Performance: the Learner Achievement Scorecard now scales to any size

Continuing the performance work, this release gives the **Learner Achievement
Scorecard** the same treatment the Currently Expired report got last time. It
used to pull three full datasets into your browser, roll them up per-learner
there, and draw a row for **every** learner at once. This release moves that work
to the server and paginates the table, so the page stays fast no matter how many
learners you have.

### What changed

- **Server-side computation.** The KPI cards, the Top Achievers leaderboard, and
  every per-learner count are now calculated on the server (and cached), so your
  browser downloads a small summary instead of three big datasets.
- **Paginated detail table.** The one-row-per-learner table now pages — use the
  controls beneath it to move through learners and change the page size. Only one
  page is loaded and rendered at a time.
- **Everything else is unchanged.** The same numbers, the same leaderboard, the
  same filters (search, theatre, region, country), the **Include expired in
  counts** toggle, and the 1 / 3 / 6-month expiring-soon window all behave exactly
  as before. **Exports still contain the full filtered set**, not just the visible
  page.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- The report's numbers were verified to match the previous version exactly across
  the toggles, filters, and every sort column/direction.
- Internal tidy-up: the shared "most-recent completion per learner+training"
  query now lives in one place, used by both this report and Currently Expired.

### Coming next

Further phases will give the same treatment to the Comparison report and the
Students list.
